properties.name: model-cards:integration_means
properties.value: Can be served with vLLM (custom granite_thinking_parser reasoning parser, qwen3_coder tool-call parser) and SGLang (v0.5.18+), via OpenAI-compatible API; also usable with Hugging Face Transformers via tokenizer.apply_chat_template with enable_thinking, low_effort and tools options; ChatML-style prompt format with <think>...</think> reasoning.

properties.name: model-cards:distribution_channels
properties.value: Open weights on Hugging Face (HF Collection, Apache 2.0 licensed); can be served with vLLM and SGLang; GitHub repository available

modelParameters.modelArchitecture: Decoder-only dense transformer (GraniteForCausalLM) with 8B parameters; Grouped Query Attention with 32 attention heads and 8 KV heads; RoPE (θ = 10,000,000); SwiGLU MLP (hidden size 12800); RMSNorm (ε = 1e-5); untied input/output embeddings; 40 layers; embedding size 4096. Dense model (no experts). No rationale for the design choices is stated.

performanceMetrics.value: Granite-4.2-8B (8B Dense) scores: AIME25 86.67, HMMT Feb25 78.33, GPQA 64.14, LiveCodeBench v6 73.24, SciCode 36.09, MMLU-Pro 74.04, IFBench (prompt) 79.33, SWE Bench Verified 47.67, BFCL (v4) 52.39, RULER 128K 71.41. The card's table gives no explicit metric names.

properties.name: model-cards:training_hardware
properties.value: NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 cluster hosted in CoreWeave (72-GPU NVLink domain intra-rack; NDR 400 Gb/s InfiniBand Fat-Tree inter-rack); total GPU count not stated

useCases: Reasoning, code generation, tool calling, agentic workflows, and multilingual dialog; also usable as the backbone model for agentic coding tools. Designed for enterprise and research use (Granite family).
Agentic workflows and agentic coding harnesses (backbone model for agentic coding tools), tool-calling systems, and multilingual dialog/chat
technicalLimitations: Multilingual performance may vary compared to English (few-shot examples can help); the model may occasionally produce inaccurate, biased, or unsafe responses; content within <think>...</think> tags is internal reasoning that may be unpolished or intermediate and not final conclusions.

properties.name: model-cards:max_output_size
properties.value: max_new_tokens is set to 8192 in thinking mode (increase for complex reasoning) and 2048 in non-thinking mode

properties.name: model-cards:design_rationale
properties.value: The card gives some rationale for training choices: SFT uses instruction-following, chain-of-thought and reasoning data to cultivate reasoning and thinking abilities; hyperparameters were tuned before scaling to all three model sizes; for the 30B model a second SFT phase up-sampled agentic data while retaining a smaller share of general replay data. RL uses GRPO across multiple environments, with verifiable rewards where available and a generative reward model for open-ended prompts; an RLHF phase tunes helpfulness, conversational quality, and safety.

properties.name: model-cards:languages
properties.value: en, de, es, fr, ja, pt, ar, cs, it, ko, nl, zh

properties.name: model-cards:eval_methodology
properties.value: Evaluations are run with an evaluation framework based on NeMo Evaluator SDK. Generation settings recommended: temperature=1.0 and top_p=0.95 across all tasks (no shots/prompts stated for benchmarks).

Base model pre-trained on a large-scale English and multilingual corpus (no provenance breakdown given).
data_acquisition: SFT corpus comprises four sources: publicly available datasets under permissive licenses, internally generated synthetic data targeting reasoning, tool calling, and chain-of-thought, agentic traces collected across diverse tasks, and a curated selection of human-authored data. Pre-training data details are deferred to the Granite 4.1 Technical Blog.
data_scope: SFT corpus comprises four sources: publicly available datasets under permissive licenses, internally generated synthetic data targeting reasoning, tool calling and chain-of-thought, agentic traces across diverse tasks, and curated human-authored data. Finetuned mostly on English instruction-response pairs plus multilingual data covering the supported languages. Base model pre-trained on a large-scale English and multilingual corpus.
